## Summary

Sam Rogers is a talent development leader with 25 years building L&D systems that move capability into practice. He is founder and CEO of PAICE.work PBC, a public benefit corporation building open infrastructure for measuring and governing human-AI collaboration. He also runs Snap Synapse LLC, the consulting practice that has funded and shaped this work.

## Current target roles

- Lead, Talent Development & Enablement
- Certification Development Lead
- Developer Education Lead
- L&D Systems Architect
- Head of Learning Engineering
- Agentic Trust Engineer

## Status

Open to senior roles where the work is making AI safer in practice.

## Core evidence

### PAICE.work PBC - Founder and CEO, 2025-present

- Built PAICE.work: adaptive behavioral simulator scoring human-AI collaboration across five dimensions on a 0-1000 scale.
- Designed AI Posture: open governance framework synthesizing people, infrastructure, and regulation signals into one maturity score.
- Built portfolio of 14 projects including Siteline, Every AI Law, AI Tool Watch, Skill Provenance, Turnfile, Knowledge-as-Code, PubLedge, AI Incident Law, Obligation First, and related open standards.
- Created agentic tooling infrastructure and workflows using modern developer tools, local LLMs, and multi-model AI orchestration.

### Snap Synapse LLC - President and Principal Consultant, 2004-present

- Built and led the first YouTube Certified Online Training Program at Google.
- Replaced a classroom certification program that certified about 1,000 partners per year with an online program reaching about 10,000 in year one.
- Owned scripting, direction, production, post-production, certification exam, and LMS standup.
- Built technical enablement, certification, and learning systems for Google/YouTube, StrongLoop, Deloitte, Robert Half / Protiviti, Sunrun, National 4-H Council, AAA, and ADP.
- Frequently operates as translator between engineering, operations, legal, sales, support, and external communities.

### Convatec - Global Learning Technology and Analytics Manager, 2020-2022

- Co-led a 9-month Manager-to-Leader development program for the top 100 managers.
- Raised Innovation and Learning Organizational Health Index score from 48 to 74 in 18 months.
- Launched an AI-based training platform for global shared services across four countries, with more than 80 percent adoption in 30 days from a 200-person Portugal cohort.
- Streamlined content offerings by 90 percent while increasing utilization and improving delivery speed by 40 percent.
- Led international DMS-to-LMS integration that produced the cleanest compliance audit in company history.

## Gaps to name plainly

Sam is not positioning himself as a deep production infrastructure engineering owner. He is strongest where learning systems, certification, AI governance, tooling, behavior change, and cross-functional enablement meet. For roles requiring full-time backend platform ownership, cloud infrastructure ownership, or narrow enterprise sales leadership, evaluate transferability carefully.
